notes: Copy to ignored configs/site.json only after an operator has independently obtained exclusive GPU allocations.
This example does not grant permission, reserve hardware or implement a site scheduler.
The current full runner needs two separately allocated GPUs because simulation remains alive while the model process runs.
All existing compute processes are refused, including your own. Shared-server co-running requires a reviewed site-specific adapter instead.
Keep interactive execution disabled until real camera, controller and model validation passes on your host.
